summary.text: Tobias Schlingensiepen is a Democratic state representative from Kansas House District 55 who has represented the district since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
Schlingensiepen is a minister who served as senior minister of the First Congregational Church of Topeka.

paragraphs.text: Tobias Schlingensiepen earned a B.A. in classical languages from the University of Kansas in 1986.

His career experience includes working as senior minister of the First Congregational Church of Topeka, as a secretary of Communities Creating Opportunity and as treasurer of the Kansas Democratic Party.
Schlingensiepen has also served as a volunteer chaplain with the Topeka Police Department and as chair and vice chair of the Topeka Center for Peace and Justice.
Schlingensiepen succeeded Annie Kuether in the District 55 seat and took office on January 9, 2023.

In the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Agriculture; Energy, Utilities, and Telecommunications; House Local Government; Corrections and Juvenile Justice; and Pensions, Investments and Benefits committees, and he is the ranking minority member of the Corrections and Juvenile Justice Committee.
He defeated Zinaia Armstead in the August 4, 2026 Democratic primary and faces Republican Lanell Griffith in the general election.
